name: Combinatorial Predicate Substitution
description: Replaced the explicit algebraic bounds (divisors) and equations (sum of cubes) with a combinatorial grid-path predicate that implicitly and uniquely restricts the values to the same binary set {1, 2} and enforces the bipartite relation cross-edge. This prevents models from immediately translating the constraints into a 2-coloring problem without first solving the non-trivial combinatorial Diophantine equation to discover the valid assignments.
